question: How much runtime storage does a cooked world need per km2, and how much do compact heightfields and a composite minimum level save?
fixture: world-cook create-hill-fixture: 48x48 cells of 32 m (1.536 km square, 2.36 km2), 33x33 heights (1 m), Y -8..350 m; same source cooked by every run
device: M2 Max, macOS, release yarra-world-cook, --terrain-materials assets, single run each

sqlite_page_size_probe.note: VACUUM after PRAGMA page_size; blobs above ~1 KB in WITHOUT ROWID tables spill to overflow pages, so no single page size wins

limitations: Procedural smooth hills; eroded or imported terrain and noisier paint compress worse. File size includes ~10 MB of SQLite overflow-page overhead at 4 KiB pages. Cook times are single runs on a warm machine.
